_about: Tracked default policy (plan 4.3). Per-stack overrides go in an untracked file (PA_POLICY_FILE, default <data dir>/policy.json) with the same shape: its `rules` are tried before these, its `default` replaces the one here, its `locked` is ignored. `locked` rules cannot be loosened by anything: they run first and only deny.

locked.reason: voice never approves or starts a merge, a push to main or a secret reveal (passkey sessions, plan 7.1, will let a human tap for these)

rules.reason: a call that would merge, push to main or reveal a secret always prompts the user, whatever tool makes it
deleting or resetting a Build profile cannot be undone from the chat: it prompts the user (D33)
the chat's routine actions run without a prompt (D33: prompts for routine actions blocked work); each call is audited
a shell command src/policy/readOnly.ts proves only reads (ls, cat, git log, gh pr view …; no redirection, expansion or secret path)
the user answering the prompt for the call it names (e2e: `pa e2e` answering for the dummy call it made, audited as such)

the chat's built-in read tools; rules cannot match paths, so the caller (the chat's PreToolUse hook, src/chat/toolGate.ts) keeps them inside the read roots (pa-home, the PA's data dir, the repos roots) and off secret-looking paths
the shared MCP surface and the chat's read tools run without a prompt (their writes are small, reversible or never show a secret)
